start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Sabse pehle, aapko rectangle, square ya polygon mein kya pasand hai?

turns.reply: Kabir, sochiye aap vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing lagate hain—poori boundary ke liye aap kya naapenge? Bittu ko baad mein batayenge.
Kabir, perimeter matlab boundary ki total length. Rectangle mein sabhi sides jodiye: 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30. Total kitna hoga?
